result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousel and the bottom-cut card are intentional and not reported. The one clear defect is the bottom navigation, where the active tab does not match the page shown. There are also a few minor contrast and consistency issues.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, but the page shown is the home/restaurant discovery feed. The 'Home' tab appears inactive (grey). This is a wrong active-state indicator and confuses navigation context.
issues.suggestion: Set the 'Home' tab as active while this screen is displayed, and reserve the active state for 'Profile' when the profile page is open.

issues.description: Secondary text is light grey on white or light backgrounds (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '(500+)', inactive nav labels, search placeholder). Contrast is low and hard to read. The white 'Order now' text and the small promo subtext over the green gradient are also fairly small.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary grey text to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast and increase the size of small labels.

issues.description: The time pill on the first 'Fastest near you' card ('15–25 min') overlaps the plate illustration and looks crowded. The card images are flat illustrations rather than real photos, and their styling is inconsistent with the popular cards.
issues.suggestion: Position the badge consistently so it doesn't overlap the image subject, and use consistent imagery across cards.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon sits on a dark translucent circle that is barely visible against the dark ramen image, and the badge styles differ ('€0 delivery' vs '−20%').
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a stronger contrast background and unify the badge treatment.
